channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Blow for Donegal as Ó Baoill set for spell on sidelines
item.description: Donegal manager Jim McGuinness has been dealt a blow with the news that Daire Ó Baoill is set to be sidelined for the next couple of weeks.

item.title: Pitch of the Year award for Castlebar
item.description: Hastings Insurance MacHale Park in Mayo has been announced as the winner of the prestigious GAA Pitch of the Year award for 2025 with Chadwick's Wexford Park coming runner up.

item.title: Rose Of Tralee-turned-Dancing Queen hails camogie roots
item.description: Katelyn Cummins, Rose Of Tralee, Dancing with the Stars contestant, apprentice electrician, disability advocate and camogie player, isn't one for backing down from a challenge.

item.title: McCormick comes in for Orchard men
item.description: Armagh boss Kieran McGeeney has made one change to his side for Sunday's Allianz Football League clash against Roscommon.

item.title: Mulligan takes St Brigid's reins
item.description: Former Mayo senior selector Damien Mulligan has been confirmed as the new manager of Roscommon giants St Brigid's.

item.title: McCarville and Wylie named to start for Monaghan in showdown with Dubs
item.description: Monaghan manager Gabriel Bannigan has named his selection for tomorrow evening's crunch Allianz Football League clash against Dublin at Croke Park (7pm).

item.title: Fitzgibbon Cup final down for decision this evening
item.description: This evening (Friday) sees the Fitzgibbon Cup final up for grabs when Mary Immaculate College take on holders University of Limerick at Croke Park.

item.title: "There's no medals won in February but it's about building"
item.description: Former Tipperary star Niall O'Meara believes the Premier men would be "very happy" with their progression in the Allianz Hurling League thus far this season.

item.title: GAA on TV: Six live games on the schedule as Allianz Football League action returns
item.description: The third-round games in the Allianz Football League are down for the decision this weekend with some intriguing clashes for fans to watch live.

item.title: Rosie Corkery appreciates the support she received during her college days
item.description: In a month where her alma mater had two teams competing in major deciders, Cork's Rosie Corkery acknowledges playing college football in UCC has played a significant part in developing her game on the inter-county stage.
